dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing observed from the mid-section toward the posterior region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no visible asymmetrical bulges or structural indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median intensity; characteristic of a sub-adult or adult phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-pixel clusters distributed across the central dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the light-grey baseline and localized darker-grey pigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, light-colored longitudinal linear mark is visible along the central dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, narrow longitudinal scar or rake mark centered on the dorsal axis.
